text: "I've ever been amazed by storms and their lightning."
zh: 风暴与闪电，一直令我深深着迷。

text: "As a child, I remember staring outside at night. Waiting and looking for that majestic glow, way beyond the horizon."
zh: 记得小时候，我总在夜里凝望窗外，等待并寻觅地平线尽头那壮丽的光芒。

text: "Yesterday, while admiring the beauty of lightning once more, I had found a rather strange coin on top of the mountain I tend to visit."
zh: 昨天，当我又一次欣赏闪电之美时，在常去的那座山顶上发现了一枚颇为古怪的硬币。

text: "As I laid my hand on it, my legs had begun to feel weak and soon after I was unconscious."
zh: 我的手刚一碰到它，双腿便开始发软，很快就失去了意识。

text: "When I awoke, the coin had disappeared and took the lightning with it."
zh: 醒来时，硬币消失了，闪电也随它一同不见了。

text: "I am now able to fully control them. Their power feels like an extension of myself. Like it had always belonged with me."
zh: 如今我已能完全操控它们。那力量宛如我身体的延伸，仿佛生来就属于我。

text: "My lightning and I... We now feel unstoppable."
zh: 我与我的闪电……如今已势不可挡。
